product.openingLowBaseline: {{name}} shows +{{change}}% — but from near-zero base{{volumeCtx}}. Not real growth, the product "woke up".
product.openingDied: {{name}} stopped selling. Discontinued or stock issue?
product.openingNew: {{name}} is new or just started moving.
product.openingStrongGrowth: {{name}} is growing strong (+{{change}}%){{volumeCtx}} with real demand.
product.stagnantStock: Has {{stock}} m² in warehouse but no recent sales. Stagnant stock.
product.stockCritical: **CRITICAL: Only {{days}} days of stock.** Order urgently.
product.stockUrgent: **Only {{days}} days of stock.** Include in next order.
product.stockHigh: High stock ({{days}} days). Verify if intentional.
product.stockGood: Well covered with {{days}} days of stock.
product.confidenceLowExtreme: The +{{change}}% looks impressive but with only {{weeks}} weeks of data, it's statistical noise.
product.confidenceLow: LOW confidence (only {{weeks}} weeks of data). Don't act based solely on this trend.
product.confidenceMedium: MEDIUM confidence — the change looks big but needs more data to confirm.
product.erraticSales: Very erratic sales — hard to predict. Keep extra safety stock.
product.dangerOversupply: High stock + declining demand = oversupply risk.
product.dangerStockout: Low stock + rising demand = stockout risk.
product.recHighDown: Don't order more. Consider price reduction.

customer.openingTierAActive: {{name}} — VIP customer active. Top 20% by volume, buying regularly.
customer.openingTierACooling: {{name}} — VIP customer cooling. {{days}} days since last purchase.
customer.openingTierADormant: {{name}} — **ALERT: VIP customer dormant.** {{days}} days without activity. Contact urgently.
customer.openingTierBActive: {{name}} — Regular customer active. Good volume, buying normally.
customer.openingTierBCooling: {{name}} — Regular customer cooling. Last purchase {{days}} days ago.
customer.openingTierBDormant: {{name}} — Regular customer dormant. No activity for {{days}} days.
customer.volumeHigh: Has purchased {{volume}} m² total — high volume customer.
customer.tooFewOrders: Too few purchases to detect a pattern.
customer.patternClockworkOverdue: {{name}} — Very regular customer (every {{gapDays}} days) but **{{daysOverdue}} days overdue**. Unusual.
customer.patternClockwork: {{name}} — Buys like clockwork every {{gapDays}} days. Predictable and valuable customer.
customer.patternPredictableOverdue: {{name}} — Normally buys every {{gapDays}} days. Already {{daysOverdue}} days overdue.
customer.patternPredictable: {{name}} — Predictable customer, buys approximately every {{gapDays}} days.
customer.patternModerateOverdue: {{name}} — Moderate pattern (every ~{{gapDays}} days). **{{daysOverdue}} days without buying**.
customer.patternErraticOverdue: {{name}} — Erratic pattern but {{daysOverdue}} days is a long time without buying.
customer.patternErratic: {{name}} — Very irregular purchases (avg {{gapDays}} days but with high variation).
customer.warningCriticalOverdue: **ALERT:** This customer is very regular but hasn't bought in {{daysOverdue}} days. Possible loss.
customer.warningPossiblyLost: No purchases in {{daysOverdue}} days. Possibly lost.
customer.warningOverduePattern: Should have bought {{daysOverdue}} days ago based on their pattern.
customer.warningModerateOverdue: {{daysOverdue}} days since last purchase, more than usual.
customer.patRecCritical: Call TODAY. Valuable customer with broken pattern.
customer.patRecClockworkOverdue: Contact soon. Very regular customer overdue.
customer.patRecTierAOverdue: Contact URGENTLY. VIP customer very overdue.
customer.patRecExpectedSoon: Contact this week, should buy soon.
